# MsgRail（dsh-msgrail）— v2.0.0 for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x
> **MsgRail** is a compact **full-history message rail** for DeepSeek Harness: one thin tick per mes
sage **you** sent in the current conversation, docked in the ambient strip below the composer. Hover
a tick to preview the message, click to jump into that part of the transcript. The rail indexes the

whole history — messages the chat has not loaded yet included.
>
> **MsgRail（消息轨道）**——DeepSeek Harn

ess 的全量消息轨道插件：在当前会话的输入框下方，为你发送的每条消息显示一根细刻度；悬停预览、点击跳转；插件自行分页加载完整历史，聊天窗口还没加载的旧消息也会出现在索引里。

## Status: 2.0.0 (DSH 0.2.x)

| Plugin | `dsh-msgrail` 2.0.0 |
| Harness | DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2** (Desktop or `dsh web`)

| License | MIT |
### What changed from 1.x
1.x patched `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout` to add a `shell.history` grid column. DSH 0.2 builds
every client package as a dynamic bundle, so that patch no longer applies. Version 2 registers thro
ugh the documented slot API instead:

| Vertical rail left of the chat | Horizontal tick strip below the composer |

ll]` |
| Imported `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` | No primitives import; local SVG/CSS only

]` |
| Imported `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` | No primitives import; local SVG/CSS only |
DSH 0.2 also ships its own turn rail on the right of the transcript. MsgRail is deliberately differe
nt: it indexes **user messages across the full history**, not turns in the loaded window.
## What it does
- **Full-history index.** On session switch the rail pages the entire durable log in the background
(`loadOlder()`), bounded so a pathological log cannot stall the UI, then keeps the tail live through

the session event subscription.
- **Hover preview.** Role, relative time and up to six lines of the

message, clamped inside the viewport.
- **Click to jump.** Scrolls the transcript toward the messag
e's position in the history. Jumping is *approximate*: DSH 0.2 removed the stable per-message DOM an

chors, so the rail maps the tick's ordinal onto the transcript scroll range.
- **Live and localized.

** New messages appear as the session grows; UI copy is registered through `ctx.locale` (zh + en).
-
**Theme-native.** Uses `--dsw-alias-*` tokens only.

## Verify

1. Open a conversation with at least one message from you.
2. A thin strip with one tick per message

appears directly below the composer; the count is shown at the right.
3. Hover a tick → preview car

d; click a tick → transcript scrolls.
4. Switch sessions → the strip rebuilds for the new session.
5
. Settings → General → Locale switch (zh/en) updates the preview labels.
## Limitations
- **Approximate jumps.** Exact per-message scrolling needs a stable anchor that the 0.2 conversation

no longer exposes to plugins.
- **Bounded paging.** The initial walk stops after 80 `loadOlder()` p

ages; a session longer than that keeps the newest ~80 pages indexed.
- **Client-only.** No agent too
ls, no host routes, no configuration.
## Uninstall
Remove the `msgrail` row (Plugin Manager → disable, or delete the `insert` block) and reload.
